## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

A cozy cafe-inspired interface that blends warm tones, soft typography, and
clean layouts for a relaxed browsing experience.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: minimal, clean
- Typography scale: desktop-first expressive scale | Fonts: primary=Poppins,
  display=Poppins, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600,
  700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#5D4432, secondary=#E9E3DD, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#F9F7F5, text=#3E2B1E
- Spacing scale: 2/4/8/12/16/24/32/48

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Cozy cafe-inspired interface with warm tones, soft typography, and clean layouts
for a relaxed browsing experience.
